in_marathi.name: Adinath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adinath is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: 'adi' meaning first and 'nath' meaning lord. This name is often associated with Shiva, the first god in the Hindu pantheon.
